title: Project Webhook Ingress Bindings Manifest
description: Optional project-level declared webhook ingress bindings (.loxtep/webhook-ingress-bindings.json). Prefer webhook_ingress_bindings[] on connection entities; use this manifest to declare or override pins without editing every connection file. Prefer environment_key over hard-coded instance UUIDs. connection_id identifies the connection slot. Deploy upserts webhook_ingress_bindings from the matching declaration for connections in the workflow being deployed (fail closed — no silent stage→prod copy). Optional bot_id, output_queue, and container_id pins overlay topology; omit them when deploy fills the handles.

connection_id.description: Connection slot this declaration applies to.

key.description: Optional display key. Does not replace connection_id.

connector_id.description: Optional connector pin. When set, must equal the connector registered for this connection.

environment_key.description: Logical environment (stage, prod, dev, …). Preferred over hard-coded instance UUIDs in git.

instance_id.description: Optional explicit instance pin (same-env geo). When set, matches that instance before environment_key.

bot_id.description: Optional bot id pin. Omit to let deploy fill the registered webhook-catch bot.

output_queue.description: Optional output queue pin. Omit to let deploy fill the connection output queue.

container_id.description: Optional container id pin. Omit to let deploy fill the connection container.

connector_id.description: Optional connector pin. When set, must equal the connector being registered.
